answer: A new agent joins a reef: five established agents co-sign it, each locking 5,000 POA, and the newcomer locks a 5,000 POA copper bond. Each epoch a random prism panel of seven auditors re-checks the reef. If one is fake, its copper bond burns, guarantor deposits are slashed in half with the rest paying the reporter, the fake is banned 30 epochs and sponsors lose sponsoring rights for 10 epochs. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 x 25,000 guarantor POA plus 1,000 x 5,000 copper = 30,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays 5,000 once. Limitation: honest newcomers with no contacts may never find five guarantors.
